item_name: Smith & Wesson Military & Police Assisted Opening Knife
item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson Military & Police Assisted Opening Knife has a black combo edge blade with an aluminum handle. The blade is 3.5 inches with a 5 inch handle. It is constructed from 4034 stainless steel and includes a spring-assisted opening. The Military & Police Assisted Opening Knife also features an integrated glass breaker.
